mapper.select: SELECT policy_idx, policy_code, policy_name, policy_type, is_active, observation_minutes, threshold_count, distinct_account_threshold, lock_duration_minutes, warning_before_count, reset_on_success, action_type, require_admin_review, review_severity, notification_category, COALESCE(ai_assist_enabled, 0) AS ai_assist_enabled, ai_risk_score_threshold, COALESCE(waf_sync_enabled, 0) AS waf_sync_enabled, description, created_at, updated_at FROM LOGIN_RISK_POLICY WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY policy_idx

SELECT policy_idx, policy_code, policy_name, policy_type, is_active, observation_minutes, threshold_count, distinct_account_threshold, lock_duration_minutes, warning_before_count, reset_on_success, action_type, require_admin_review, review_severity, notification_category, COALESCE(ai_assist_enabled, 0) AS ai_assist_enabled, ai_risk_score_threshold, COALESCE(waf_sync_enabled, 0) AS waf_sync_enabled, description, created_at, updated_at FROM LOGIN_RISK_POLICY WHERE policy_code = #{policyCode} AND is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE LOGIN_RISK_POLICY SET policy_name = #{policyName}, is_active = #{active}, observation_minutes = #{observationMinutes}, threshold_count = #{thresholdCount}, distinct_account_threshold = #{distinctAccountThreshold}, lock_duration_minutes = #{lockDurationMinutes}, warning_before_count = #{warningBeforeCount}, reset_on_success = #{resetOnSuccess}, action_type = #{actionType}, require_admin_review = #{requireAdminReview}, review_severity = #{reviewSeverity}, notification_category = #{notificationCategory}, ai_assist_enabled = #{aiAssistEnabled}, ai_risk_score_threshold = #{aiRiskScoreThreshold}, waf_sync_enabled = #{wafSyncEnabled}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE policy_idx = #{policyIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOGIN_RISK_COUNTER (policy_code, subject_type, subject_key, attempt_count, action_type, blocked_until, detail_message, observed_started_at, last_event_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{policyCode}, 'IP', #{ipAddress}, 1, 'IP_LOGIN_LOCK', #{blockedUntil}, #{detailMessage}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, blocked_until = VALUES(blocked_until), detail_message = VALUES(detail_message), last_event_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM LOGIN_RISK_COUNTER WHERE (subject_type = 'USER' AND subject_key = CAST(#{userIdx} AS CHAR)) OR (subject_type = 'IP' AND subject_key = #{ipAddress} AND action_type = 'IP_LOGIN_LOCK')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOGIN_RISK_EVENT (policy_code, event_type, subject_type, subject_key, user_idx, ip_address, login_identifier, threshold_count, observed_count, action_type, decision_status, review_required, blocked_until, request_id, flow_trace_id, detail_message, created_at) VALUES (#{policyCode}, #{eventType}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectKey}, #{userIdx}, #{ipAddress}, #{loginIdentifier}, #{thresholdCount}, #{observedCount}, #{actionType}, #{decisionStatus}, #{reviewRequired}, #{blockedUntil}, #{requestId}, #{flowTraceId}, #{detailMessage}, NOW())

INSERT INTO LOGIN_RISK_REVIEW_QUEUE (policy_code, review_type, severity, subject_type, subject_key, user_idx, ip_address, request_id, flow_trace_id, summary, detail_message, review_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{policyCode}, #{reviewType}, #{severity}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectKey}, #{userIdx}, #{ipAddress}, #{requestId}, #{flowTraceId}, #{summary}, #{detailMessage}, 'PENDING', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_idx FROM USERS u WHERE u.account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.user_role IN ('ADMIN','SUPERADMIN') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCE p WHERE p.user_idx = u.user_idx AND p.notification_category = #{category} AND p.is_enabled = 0 )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MYPAGE_FEED_NOTIFICATION (user_idx, source_type, source_id, message, target_url, created_at) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{sourceType}, COALESCE(#{sourceId}, 0), #{message}, #{targetUrl}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT rq.*, p.policy_name, u.user_id, u.nickname, reviewer.user_id AS reviewed_by_user_id FROM LOGIN_RISK_REVIEW_QUEUE rq LEFT JOIN LOGIN_RISK_POLICY p ON p.policy_code = rq.policy_code LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = rq.user_idx LEFT JOIN USERS reviewer ON reviewer.user_idx = rq.reviewed_by_user_idx
AND rq.review_status = #{status} AND rq.severity = #{severity} AND rq.review_type = #{reviewType}
AND ( rq.policy_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rq.subject_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rq.ip_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rq.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rq.detail_message LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE rq.review_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 WHEN 'HOLD' THEN 1 WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE rq.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, rq.created_at DESC

SELECT rq.*, p.policy_name, u.user_id, u.nickname, reviewer.user_id AS reviewed_by_user_id FROM LOGIN_RISK_REVIEW_QUEUE rq LEFT JOIN LOGIN_RISK_POLICY p ON p.policy_code = rq.policy_code LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = rq.user_idx LEFT JOIN USERS reviewer ON reviewer.user_idx = rq.reviewed_by_user_idx WHERE rq.review_idx = #{reviewIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE LOGIN_RISK_REVIEW_QUEUE SET review_status = #{reviewStatus}, reviewed_by_user_idx = #{reviewedByUserIdx}, reviewed_at = NOW(), review_comment = #{reviewComment}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE review_idx = #{reviewIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IP_BLOCKLIST ( ip_address, block_target_key, block_request_id, rule_action, control_mode, rule_origin_type, match_type, cidr_notation, source_scope, block_category, user_idx, block_type, blocked_by_user_idx, source_action_type, source_action_group_id, source_user_idx, source_ip_address, blocked_at, reason, is_active, is_effective_active, effective_status, effective_status_reason, effective_synced_at, effective_synced_by_source, last_control_action, last_control_by_user_idx, last_control_at, last_control_reason, priority, last_synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ipAddress}, #{blockTargetKey}, #{blockRequestId}, 'BLOCK', 'MANUAL', 'LOGIN_RISK_REVIEW', #{matchType}, #{cidrNotation}, 'GLOBAL', 'LOGIN_RISK', #{sourceUserIdx}, 'IP_ONLY', #{blockedByUserIdx}, #{sourceActionType}, #{sourceActionGroupId}, #{sourceUserIdx}, #{sourceIpAddress}, NOW(), #{reason}, TRUE, TRUE, 'EFFECTIVE', '관리자 검토 승인으로 활성화되었습니다.', NOW(), 'ADMIN_REVIEW', 'CREATE', #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW(), #{reason}, 150, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO LOGIN_RISK_WAF_SYNC_QUEUE (source_type, source_id, sync_action, target_type, target_value, status, detail_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{syncAction}, #{targetType}, #{targetValue}, #{status}, #{detailMessage}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO LOGIN_RISK_AI_ASSESSMENT (source_type, source_id, risk_score, risk_label, model_name, summary, raw_payload, created_at) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{riskScore}, #{riskLabel}, #{modelName}, #{summary}, #{rawPayload}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.preference_idx, u.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, categories.notification_category, COALESCE(p.is_enabled, 1) AS is_enabled, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM USERS u JOIN ( SELECT 'LOGIN_RISK' AS notification_category UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS_APPLICATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'REPORT' UNION ALL SELECT 'INQUIRY' UNION ALL SELECT 'BLOCK_REVIEW' ) categories LEFT JOIN ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCE p ON p.user_idx = u.user_idx AND p.notification_category = categories.notification_category WHERE u.user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY categories.notification_category
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCE (user_idx, notification_category, is_enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{notificationCategory}, #{enabled}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_enabled = VALUES(is_enabled), updated_at = NOW()
